result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and it comes back from all six listing and lookup paths. The full offline suite passes (608 tests, including a new one for the description).

What changed:

- **`schema.sql`**: new nullable `description VARCHAR(200)` column on `promotion`.
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: `description` added as the last record component. It is null when none was given.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: new six-argument `createPromotion(..., category, description)`. A blank description is stored as null. The existing five-argument method delegates with a null description, so the ~40 existing callers are untouched.
- **`DataStore.java`**: the insert writes the description. The six promotion queries (lookup by code, active on date, active in region, by category, best for category on date, unused in period) select it and pass it into `Promotion`.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: new `keepsDescriptionOfPromotion` test covering the listings and the no-description case.

I did not add a description to any `DemoScenario` promotion, so demo data still has none. I also did not commit anything.
